body:
selfhost/emit.prn now emits a real forward prototype for every top-level defn, closing the 'callee must textually precede caller' gap several earlier test fixtures had to work around this same day. New emit-defn-prototype reuses emit-defn's own signature-building pieces; emit-program runs a real prototype pre-pass before any bodies, matching the C reference emitter's own established convention. 5 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check proving a caller-before-callee program (the exact ordering that used to trigger a gcc implicit-declaration error) now compiles and runs correctly. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean, including the multi-file build-files negative case remaining intact. PARENA commit 3707199.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: forward-prototype support
